message:
I hear what you're saying, Christin: state governments are using taxpayer dollars to help T-Netix and Securus rip off private citizens, and it's enough to make us all mad.

Most of us here, though, want to talk to one another and share ideas, and sometimes that's kinda tough when writing in ALL CAPS makes it seem like PEOPLE ARE YELLING AT EACH OTHER. I know you're not yelling, even though we're angry and frustrated, so: any chance you might be OK with not using all caps?

But yeah, I totally agree with you: pre-paying for services you might not ever use is extortion, and it's wrong. [T-Netix](http://www.t-netix.com/) should be ashamed, Securus should be ashamed, and both companies are vultures. How unsurprising that the venal and spineless corporate mouthpiece who calls himself ["Knowledge Is Power"](/weblog/2004/06/26/t-netix.html#comment-23834) and ["Power Corrupts"](/weblog/2004/06/26/t-netix.html#comment-23974) hasn't had anything more to say: shameful avarice, ultimately, speaks for itself, and displays that combination of hubris and cowardice unique to the fat and wealthy.

To paraphrase Harlan Ellison: the fact that [swine-boy Dick Falcone](http://www.t-netix.com/staff_default.asp) walks erect has everything to do with the mechanics of skeletal arrangement, and nothing to do with morality, intelligence, or ethics.
